MXWD_Fundamental_PC1: First principal component of the supplied MSCI World fundamental valuation indicators.
SA_CDS_Slope: Slope factor of the South African sovereign credit-default-swap term structure.
US_NB_Curvature: Curvature factor of the US nominal government bond yield curve.
Shape of the nominal yield curve
RandPPP_Factor_Inst_TS_ST: Short-term time-series measure of the institutional rand purchasing-power-parity valuation factor.
Rand valuation relative to purchasing power
CONCCONF.Index: US Conference Board Consumer Confidence Index.
USDZAR_EntDyn: Change in the supplied entropy measure of the USD/ZAR exchange-rate series.
GLD_LempZiev: Supplied Lempel–Ziv complexity measure of the gold price series.
GlobalEquity_EntDyn: Change in the supplied entropy measure of the global equity series.
GLD_RollKurt: Rolling kurtosis of the supplied gold series.
GLD_RollSkew: Rolling skewness of the supplied gold series.
GLD_StructBreak: Supplied structural-break statistic for the gold price series.
Changes in the gold price regime
GlobalEquityGret1: One-month geometric return of the supplied global equity series.
GenComIndexPC2: Second principal component of the supplied broad commodity indicator set.
GenComIndexPC1_QS: Quantile-scaled first principal component of the supplied broad commodity indicator set.
Commodity conditions relative to their distribution
TOP40.Index.Price.to.Book.Ratio_Diff: First difference of the FTSE/JSE Top 40 price-to-book ratio.
TOP40.Index.Price.to.Ebitda_Diff: First difference of the FTSE/JSE Top 40 price-to-EBITDA ratio.
MXWD.Index.Price.to.Sales.Ratio_Diff: First difference of the MSCI World price-to-sales ratio.
SA_NB_Slope: Slope factor of the South African nominal government bond yield curve.
GlobalEquityTS: Level of the supplied global equity index time series.
VolTermStructPC1: First principal component of the supplied equity implied-volatility term structure.
US_RB_Curvature: Curvature factor of the US real government bond yield curve.
Shape of the real yield curve
GLD_RollSD: Rolling standard deviation of the supplied gold series.
MXWD_PEvFwdPE: Supplied comparison of the MSCI World current and forward price-to-earnings ratios.
Current valuation relative to expected earnings
zrel_momentum_vs_value_12: Current weekly momentum versus value return spread minus its trailing 12-week mean, divided by its trailing 12-week sample standard deviation.
relvol_momentum_vs_value_12: Trailing 12-week sample standard deviation of the weekly momentum versus value return spread.
corr_momentum_value_12: Trailing 12-week Pearson correlation of the weekly momentum and value returns.
volratio_momentum_value_12: Trailing 12-week sample standard deviation of momentum returns divided by that of value returns.
mom1m_momentum_vs_value: Compounded momentum return over the trailing 4 weeks minus the compounded value return over the same weeks.
mom3m_momentum_vs_value: Compounded momentum return over the trailing 12 weeks minus the compounded value return over the same weeks.
zrel_momentum_vs_quality_12: Current weekly momentum versus quality return spread minus its trailing 12-week mean, divided by its trailing 12-week sample standard deviation.
relvol_momentum_vs_quality_12: Trailing 12-week sample standard deviation of the weekly momentum versus quality return spread.
corr_momentum_quality_12: Trailing 12-week Pearson correlation of the weekly momentum and quality returns.
volratio_momentum_quality_12: Trailing 12-week sample standard deviation of momentum returns divided by that of quality returns.
mom1m_momentum_vs_quality: Compounded momentum return over the trailing 4 weeks minus the compounded quality return over the same weeks.
mom3m_momentum_vs_quality: Compounded momentum return over the trailing 12 weeks minus the compounded quality return over the same weeks.
zrel_value_vs_quality_12: Current weekly value versus quality return spread minus its trailing 12-week mean, divided by its trailing 12-week sample standard deviation.
relvol_value_vs_quality_12: Trailing 12-week sample standard deviation of the weekly value versus quality return spread.
corr_value_quality_12: Trailing 12-week Pearson correlation of the weekly value and quality returns.
volratio_value_quality_12: Trailing 12-week sample standard deviation of value returns divided by that of quality returns.
mom1m_value_vs_quality: Compounded value return over the trailing 4 weeks minus the compounded quality return over the same weeks.
mom3m_value_vs_quality: Compounded value return over the trailing 12 weeks minus the compounded quality return over the same weeks.
